facts.text: Meridian, Colorado, emerged as a planned community in the late 20th century amid the rapid suburban expansion of the Denver metropolitan area.
The Meridian CDP is located in northern Douglas County at 39.53’89”N 104.84’75”W at 5,964 feet above sea level, higher than Denver.
Meridian experiences a cold semi‑arid climate, with highs of 88°F in summer, lows of 17°F in winter, and about 245 sunny days each year.
The Meridian International Business Center hosts the headquarters of three Fortune 500 companies, including Dish Network, Liberty Media, and Qurate Retail.
As a master‑planned community, Meridian incorporates man‑made lakes and extensive greenbelts designed to enhance open space within its developed areas.
The MMD was created to provide utilities for undeveloped land southeast of Denver, sparking organized growth during the 1980s suburban boom.
